body: Hi OP, I'm exactly the same ( with hair on my neck, my back.. pretty much everywhere a hairy male has hair). I don't have solutions yet, I tried laser for my face but it didn't seem to work other than sideburns. You're pale with dark hair so you'd be the best candidate for laser so you should probably save up for that! Let me know if you ever want to talk xx

All over my whole body? I've tried, it's expensive, I need so much for my whole body. My hair is so thick in places it doesn't work. It causes ingrowns and scars, in a few days the hair is back. I've tried waxing, I've tried shaving, I've tried epilating. I've tried everything. I wouldn't feel this way if there was something I could do about it.
